title: ACTREC Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 02 Junior Engineer and Psychologist Posts
description: The Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC)  has announced the official notification for 2026. To fill the 02 vacancies for Junior Engineer and Psychologist Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in Diploma in Civil Engineering, M.A can grab this chance and apply for the ACTREC Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible ...
